name: Tea with a stranger
source:
While on the run, you bump into a mysterious but attractive stranger who seems to know who you are and is offering to help you hide.

[From [url=https://whitefort.itch.io/tea-with-a-stranger]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在逃亡过程中，你遇到了一个神秘但有吸引力的陌生人，他似乎知道你是谁，并愿意帮助你隐藏。

[来自[url=https://whitefort.itch.io/tea-with-a-stranger]itch.io[/url]]
